operators.name: custom_reflection_pad2d
semantics: Applies ReflectionPad2d as in PyTorch: pads left, right, top, bottom using reflection without repeating edge for pad < dimension
Input x is a 4D CUDA tensor float32, pad is CPU int64 tensor of 4 values (left, right, top, bottom)
Output shape: H_out = H_in + top + bottom, W_out = W_in + left + right
Output is on same CUDA device, float32, contiguous
Corresponds to reference statement: x = self.pad(x)

operators.name: custom_roll
semantics: Performs torch.roll on specified dims with given shifts, preserving dtype and device
Supports positive and negative shifts; for each dim shift is modulo dimension size
Output is a new contiguous CUDA tensor with same shape as input
Corresponds to reference statement: x = torch.roll(x, shifts=self.roll_shifts, dims=(2,3))
ReflectionPad2d with pad=(1,2,1,2): left=1, right=2, top=1, bottom=2
Padding uses reflection without edge repetition for pad < dimension
Shifts H by +1 (wrap around), W by -1 (wrap around)
Return final tensor after roll, shape [16,3,515,4099], dtype float32, device cuda
